enigmaticdice.mob_drop.0: §6Funny. He was carrying something that belongs to you.
enigmaticdice.mob_drop.1: §6You took what should’ve been yours all along.
enigmaticdice.mob_drop.2: §6Looks like he didn’t even know he was carrying it.
enigmaticdice.mob_drop.3: §6And why was he lugging that around, anyway?
enigmaticdice.advancement_earned.0: §6Hmm... a worthy achievement. I suppose you've earned this.
enigmaticdice.advancement_earned.1: §6Who would've thought... you're not that simple after all. Take the die.
enigmaticdice.advancement_earned.2: §6Well then, not bad. Take this for your effort.
enigmaticdice.advancement_earned.3: §6Keep it up. I’d say you’ve earned this.
enigmaticdice.effect.luck: §d§oMay luck always be on your side
enigmaticdice.effect.regeneration: §d§oLet the wound become just a memory
enigmaticdice.event.lightning_wrath: §cThis is what divine wrath looks like!
enigmaticdice.event.mimic: §5Oh, looks like you've got a new friend! Though… I think he's more interested in your inventory.
enigmaticdice.event.dummy_chest: §5Crack it open if you can… there's treasure inside!
enigmaticdice.event.warped_toads: §9Looks like the universe decided you didn't have enough toads. Now you have three.
enigmaticdice.event.brood_awakens: §cIs this your plan? Drown the world in legs and wings?
enigmaticdice.event.skyfall_training: §cNo parachute found. Take this water bucket!
enigmaticdice.event.mini_size_shrink: §5For the next 10 minutes you are a mini-zombie
enigmaticdice.event.ant_size_shrink: §6For the next 10 minutes you are an ant
enigmaticdice.event.centipede.0: §cWhy are there so many legs in this world? Oh right… That’s your problem.
enigmaticdice.event.centipede.1: §cHow many legs does a centipede have? I hope you have enough time to count them.
enigmaticdice.event.centipede.2: §cDid someone order an extra-long monster? No refunds!
enigmaticdice.event.centipede.3: §cIt could have been bigger… but then the game would crash.
enigmaticdice.event.centipede.4: §cIf this is a dream, it’s time to wake up. If it’s not… then you’re out of luck.
enigmaticdice.event.centipede.5: §cCongratulations! You’ve summoned the longest pet! Too bad it doesn’t like you.
enigmaticdice.event.centipede.6: §cOut of all possible outcomes… You got the one with the most legs.
enigmaticdice.event.centipede.7: §cBugs in the house are annoying. But when the house is inside the bug, it’s even worse.
enigmaticdice.event.centipede.8: §cYou woke it up. It got out on the wrong foot… or maybe the wrong hundred.
enigmaticdice.event.wonderland_field.0: §5There's a sense of treasure in the air... Maybe you should take a look around?
enigmaticdice.event.wonderland_field.1: §5If I were you, I'd take a look around… There might be something valuable nearby!
enigmaticdice.event.wonderland_field.2: §5Good news: chests have appeared nearby! No bad news. Probably.
enigmaticdice.event.teleport_to_biome.1: §5Here's a new point on your adventure map!
enigmaticdice.event.teleport_to_biome.2: §5Try not to ruin this biome, okay?
enigmaticdice.event.teleport_to_biome.3: §5You have no idea where you're about to end up...
enigmaticdice.event.teleport_to_biome.4: §5Congratulations, you've discovered another corner of this world!
enigmaticdice.event.teleport_to_biome.5: §5Sometimes the most amazing adventures begin with a single teleport...
enigmaticdice.event.teleport_to_structur: §5Looks like you need to go west.
§5It seems like you're getting close to something important — head west!
enigmaticdice.event.teleport_to_world_ed: §6It seems your journey home will be a long one.
enigmaticdice.event.horse.0: §9Don't tell me you don't have a driver's license for a horse.
enigmaticdice.event.candicorn: §9You called for a dessert with hooves. Get out the marmalade sword!
enigmaticdice.event.carcass: §9Now you have your own undead army.
enigmaticdice.event.raycat: §9Is it sure it has nine lives?
enigmaticdice.event.vallumraptor: §9Looks like you've made some new friends.
§cCreeper Party! Now You Don't See Them
enigmaticdice.gift.antimatter: §6Who would've thought antimatter looked like this?

enigmaticdice.event.grottol: §bA Grottol! Quick, grab a pickaxe before it runs off with your diamonds.
enigmaticdice.event.creeper_minions: §aThree tiny creepers, all yours. They promise not to explode. Mostly.
enigmaticdice.event.pocket_villager: §aA villager in your pocket. Don't ask how he got there.
enigmaticdice.event.biplane: §9The sky is yours. Don't forget the fuel.
enigmaticdice.event.starbuncle: §eA Starbuncle wants a job. It moves boxes, you pay in cuddles.
enigmaticdice.event.ferret: §aA ferret has adopted you. No take-backs.
enigmaticdice.event.cockroaches: §eYou hear tiny footsteps. A lot of tiny footsteps.
enigmaticdice.event.pickarang: §9What goes around, comes around. Mines on the way, too.
enigmaticdice.event.backpack: §aMore pockets! You can never have too many pockets.
enigmaticdice.event.target_dummy: §eSomeone to practice on. He won't complain.
enigmaticdice.event.capuchin: §aA monkey! It's on your side. Probably.
enigmaticdice.event.snuffle: §bA wild Snuffle! Fluffy, cold, and very huggable.
enigmaticdice.event.umvuthana: §cYou hear drums. They don't sound friendly.
enigmaticdice.event.toretoise: §aA Toretoise with ore on its back. Be gentle, it's carrying your paycheck.
enigmaticdice.event.warp_stone: §bHome is just a stone's throw away. Literally.
enigmaticdice.event.jetpack: §9A jetpack! Half a tank of hydrogen, use it wisely.
enigmaticdice.event.whoopee_cushion: §eThe dice thought you'd find this funny.
enigmaticdice.event.slingshot: §aEverything is ammo if you're brave enough.
enigmaticdice.event.megatorch: §6Let there be light. And no monsters.
enigmaticdice.event.sculk_snapper: §3A Sculk Snapper took a liking to you. Don't ask what it eats.
enigmaticdice.event.dropbears: §cDon't look up. Actually, do look up.
enigmaticdice.event.naga: §cSomething with wings and fangs is circling above.
enigmaticdice.event.sculk_leeches: §cSomething small and slimy is crawling toward you. Several somethings.
enigmaticdice.event.wraiths: §cThe air goes cold. You are not alone.
enigmaticdice.event.rattlesnakes: §cHear that rattle? Don't step on anything.
enigmaticdice.event.irradiated: §cYou feel a strange tingling. That's probably fine.
enigmaticdice.event.birts: §eTweet tweet! They have no idea why they're here either.
enigmaticdice.event.everlasting_beef: §6A steak that never runs out. Don't ask where it comes from.
enigmaticdice.event.filch_lizards: §cHold on to your pockets. These lizards have sticky fingers.
enigmaticdice.event.zombie_clown: §cHonk honk. It's not here to make you laugh.
enigmaticdice.event.rotspawn: §cA foul smell rises from below. The rot has found you.
enigmaticdice.event.volts: §cThe air crackles. Something charged is coming.
enigmaticdice.event.hammock: §eTake a break. You've earned it. Probably.
enigmaticdice.event.chameleon: §eA chameleon! Or is it? Hard to tell.
enigmaticdice.event.catalyst: §9A key to a world below. Use it wisely.
enigmaticdice.event.ender_pouch: §5A pocket to your Ender Chest. Very convenient.
enigmaticdice.event.treasure_slime: §6A Treasure Slime! Catch it before it bounces away.
enigmaticdice.event.yeti: §cBig, white, furry and very, very angry.
enigmaticdice.event.goblins: §cGoblins! They want your stuff, and they brought friends.
enigmaticdice.event.gadflies: §cBzzz. These ones bite harder than mosquitoes.
enigmaticdice.event.umber_spiders: §cSomething with too many legs is crawling out of the dark.
enigmaticdice.event.stoneling: §eA little rock with legs. It's shy, be nice.
enigmaticdice.event.goober: §eA Goober! Big, slow, and absolutely harmless.
enigmaticdice.event.lost_miner: §aA lost miner stumbled in. He has things to trade.
enigmaticdice.event.extendo_grip: §9Now you can reach the top shelf.
enigmaticdice.event.red_panda: §aA red panda! It's yours now. Look at its little face.
enigmaticdice.event.umbrella: §bRain or shine, you'll float down gently.
enigmaticdice.event.shattered: §cSomething crawled up from the deep dark. It heard you.
enigmaticdice.event.pumpkin_dunces: §cThe pumpkins have come to life, and they're not happy about it.
enigmaticdice.event.wicked: §cA wicked grin in the dark. Two of them.
enigmaticdice.event.terror: §cYou feel a chill down your spine. The Terror is here.
enigmaticdice.event.shima_enagas: §eThree fluffy little birds came to say hi.
enigmaticdice.event.flute: §eA flute! Play a tune, maybe your pets will listen.
enigmaticdice.event.shepherds_pie: §6A whole shepherd's pie. Share it, or don't.
enigmaticdice.event.crow: §aA crow has chosen you. It likes shiny things.
enigmaticdice.event.mystery_scroll: §dA scroll appears. What's written on it? Only one way to find out.
enigmaticdice.event.mystery_present: §6A present from the dice! Place it down and open it.
enigmaticdice.event.forgotten: §cSomething long forgotten has come back for you.
enigmaticdice.event.goblin_rider: §cIs that a goblin… riding a spider?
enigmaticdice.event.tremorsaurus: §6A Tremorsaurus! It's tame, and it's yours. Hop on.
enigmaticdice.event.suns_blessing: §6The sun smiles upon you. Show them its power.
enigmaticdice.event.ender_flu: §cYou don't feel so good. Find some milk before it's too late.
enigmaticdice.event.clinging: §eUp is down, down is up. Try walking on the ceiling.
enigmaticdice.event.frozen: §cBrrr! Hold still, you don't have a choice.
enigmaticdice.event.hydra_zombie: §cCut one down and two more take its place.
enigmaticdice.event.blinking_creeper: §cThat creeper just blinked. Don't blink back.
enigmaticdice.event.champion: §cA Champion has come to test you.
enigmaticdice.event.growing_slime: §cIt's small now. Don't let it heal.
enigmaticdice.event.difficulty_spike: §cThe world grows more hostile toward you.
enigmaticdice.event.bottle_of_sanity: §bA Bottle of Sanity. Drink it when the world gets too mean.
enigmaticdice.event.wrapped_spell: §dA present with a spell inside. Unwrap it carefully.
enigmaticdice.event.sunbird_blessing: §6The Sunbird blesses you. Spread your wings.
enigmaticdice.event.pocket_golem: §aA tiny Iron Golem! Small, but it hits like a big one.
enigmaticdice.event.wilden_pack: §cThe wild magic of the forest wants you gone.
enigmaticdice.event.pyromancer: §cA Pyromancer heard you insulted fire magic.
enigmaticdice.event.dicer: §cYou rolled the dice. Now meet The Dicer.
enigmaticdice.event.caniac: §cSweet tooth? It has a sharper one.
enigmaticdice.event.gummy_bear: §eA Gummy Bear! Please don't eat it.
enigmaticdice.event.red_merchant: §aThe Red Merchant has wares, if you have coin.
enigmaticdice.event.priest: §aA wandering priest offers you a blessing.
enigmaticdice.event.robit: §9A fully charged Robit, at your service.
enigmaticdice.event.watcher: §cYou feel like you're being watched. Because you are.
enigmaticdice.event.gammaroaches: §cThese cockroaches glow. That's never a good sign.
enigmaticdice.event.notor: §eA little drone wants to follow you around. Beep boop.
enigmaticdice.event.shulker_pillagers: §cPillagers with shulker magic. Keep your feet on the ground.
enigmaticdice.event.vampire_bats: §cA swarm of bats, and they're hungry.
enigmaticdice.event.lanterns: §eTwo glowing Lanterns float by. Pretty, aren't they?
enigmaticdice.event.limpet: §aA Limpet with treasure in its shell. Grab a pickaxe.
enigmaticdice.event.cloud_in_a_bottle: §bA cloud in a bottle. Jump, then jump again.
